observations: Multiple large lead-acid batteries stacked on a floor.
Batteries appear dusty and heavily used.
A logo resembling the Luminous brand is visible on the battery in the lower right of photo 0.
Manufacturer labels are present on several batteries but the text is illegible due to blur.
The seller's text indicates these are 'dead' or 'scrap' units, though the text reads like an advertisement for a buying service.

claims.evidence: Remote visual inspection cannot confirm the electrical state or internal health of the batteries.
While they appear used, their status as scrap depends on internal plate condition which is not visible.

risks.proof: Clear photos of the labels on each battery showing the Ah rating (e.g., 100Ah, 150Ah, 200Ah).
A photo showing all batteries in the lot arranged so they can be counted individually.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a lot of 4 batteries

risks.proof: Photos of all sides and the bottom of the battery casings.

proof_requests: Close-up, legible photos of the labels on every battery to confirm capacity (Ah).
A wide shot showing all batteries included in the sale clearly separated.
Photos of the battery terminals and all sides of the casings to check for cracks or leaks.
response.reason: The capacity (Ah) of the batteries, which is the primary determinant of scrap value, cannot be read from the provided photo. Additionally, the seller's text is ambiguous as to whether they are buying or selling.
